thread:
alex_t: quick scope lock for the "console-lite" observability panel. need a minimal GA that answers pilot asks without blowing infra costs.

maria_k: pilot asks: consolidated route cost, small error hotspot view, trace deep-link from an error row, and a sampling control for noisy routes. PD alerts as a light hook.

samir: engineering reality: no full-trace ingest for GA. implement trace deep-link (lookup by trace_id) + sampling presets. confirm trace_id passthrough for older pipelines or show 'trace not available'.
jordan_p: acceptance criteria to map to APIs: (1) route cost row (7d sparkline) (2) error hotspot table with top endpoints (3) "view trace" action -> opens trace viewer if available (4) sampling presets: low/med/high (5) PagerDuty webhook MVP (6) retention UI (default 7d).
emily: i'll mock a compact row and sampling UI by EOD. maria, i'll include the billing CTA.
maria_k: i'll draft the retention warning: "Extending retention increases storage charges" and loop legal.
samir: infra checklist: add sampling flag to routing policy, ensure serializer preserves trace_id, circuit-breaker for trace-forwarder (>5% error -> fallback to link-only), surface KV hit metrics per-route.
opsbot: deploybot: feature gate created: feature=console-lite-observe, env=staging, owners=[samir,jordan_p]
alex_t: decision: ship GA with must-haves above, default 7d, gate 30d behind enterprise, use presets for sampling. rollout: 5 pilot orgs -> 50 -> GA. reconvene in 48h after mocks + infra plan.
